headline: Is my energy keeping my soulmate away?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see them, and your hand went to the one who came ready.
Look at his table. A cup, a coin, a blade and a wand — all out.
You asked if your energy is keeping your soulmate away. What catches me is that all four things are still out.
Still, nobody has come. And you've started to think you're the reason.
Whatever is in the way of this doesn't waver. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing that…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing told them apart, and you found the calmest man here.
He's upside down, held at the ankle. Look at his face, though — it's calm.
You asked if your energy is keeping your soulmate away. What holds my eye is where that rope goes.
And yet nobody has come. And the reason you're offering me is yourself.
Something stands between you and this, and not off in the distance. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and yours was the one in full sun.
Look at the sky behind him. Gold, and not a cloud in it.
You asked if your energy is keeping your soulmate away. Open daylight, and a step already taken — that's what this one shows me.
But nobody has come. And you're the one turning that question on yourself.
Something arrives right when this gets close. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind it…
